name: Oni
summary: A shape-shifting fiend that claws and fires nightmare rays, regenerates, and casts trickery spells.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.text: The oni regains 10 {ref:glossary/hit-points} at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The oni makes two Claw or Nightmare Ray attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Nightmare Ray
actions.onHit: and the target has the {ref:condition/frightened} condition until the start of the oni's next turn.

actions.name: Shape-Shift
actions.text: The oni shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid or a Large Giant, or it returns to its true form. Other than its size, its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

bonusActions.name: Invisibility
bonusActions.text: The oni casts *{ref:spell/invisibility}* on itself, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
